name: Sheffield Hallam University

sources.title: These are the type of questions you may be asked in your visa interview (SHU credibility interview practice questions PDF)
topics: Living as a student in the UK
quotes: Why do you want to study in the UK?
What are the benefits of studying in the UK compared to your home country or USA/Canada/Australia etc.?
Why did you choose to study at Sheffield Hallam University?
How did you find out about it?
Which other colleges / universities have you considered?
Do you know anyone who has already studied there?
Where is the college / university?
Do you know roughly how large the college / university is?
What facilities are you expecting at the college/university?
What course are you studying and how long is it?
Does this course offer any professional recognition?
What qualifications will you receive?
How is your chosen course assessed?
Why did you choose this course and how does it relate to your previous study?
Can you explain the gaps in your study/professional history?
What is the relevance of the course to your future career path?
How are you funding your studies?
If you have taken out a bank loan to finance your studies, how do you intend to repay it?
Where do you intend to live while you are in the UK?
Have you already arranged accommodation?
If you have dependants travelling with you, what will they be doing while you are studying?
Have you organised schooling for your children?
Do you intend to work in the UK during your studies?
If so, do you know how many hours you would be permitted to work under Tier 4?
What do you intend to do after finishing your course?
If you intend to return home to seek employment, which companies do you hope to apply to?
Are you planning to stay in the UK on completion to study for a higher award?
Are you thinking of transferring to another institution on completing this course?
unmapped: Have you organised schooling for your children?
sources.notes: PDF (metadata: created Oct 2016) extracted locally with pypdf. Intro: 'These are the type of questions you may be asked in your visa interview. We recommend you practise answering questions of this kind.' Refers to Tier 4, so it predates the Student route but is still linked from the current SHU page.

sources.title: Credibility interviews | Sheffield Hallam University
sources.notes: Describes the UKVI interview: 'You will usually be interviewed during your biometrics appointment at the visa application centre.' 'Failure to attend your scheduled interview without a valid reason may result in your visa application being refused.' Snippet adds: 'If you are pursuing a PhD, you might be asked more in-depth questions about your research.' Links the credibility-interviews-information.pdf. No Enroly/CAS Shield mention on this page. questionIds here are topic-level mappings only.

sources.title: CAS Shield
sources.notes: shu.cas-shield.com resolves (HTTP 200) and serves Enroly's CAS Shield login page (page text contains 'Enroly' and 'CAS Shield'), so Sheffield Hallam University uses Enroly CAS Shield for its CAS process. Enroly pre-CAS interviews draw randomised questions from themed banks; no question list is published on the site.
